pending_commit.commit_message: FROMLIST: ath10k: enable per peer tx stats feature Tx stats are available on pktlog event. tx_stats histogram feature enabled with a module parameter. This patch enables ATH_PKTLOG_PEER_STATS pktlog event and checks WMI_PEER_STATS service is enabled. To enable tx_stats feature we are reducing the number of peers. FROMLIST: ath10k: Add support to parse per station tx stats for 10.2.4 Per peer tx stats are available on pktlog tx stats event. WMI_PEER_STATS service to be enabled to parse the tx stats. tx stats histogram has success/failed/retried packets and bytes info per rate/mcs, bw and nss. GI packets/bytes are also updated. tx duration and BA fails are also supported. fmap: Finds correct FMAP with same logic from vboot host lib. The futility and flashrom already have a standard way to prevent finding wrong FMAP when multiple FMAP structures live in same file. In additional to FMAP name matching, we should follow how futility and flashrom find FMAP header to make sure the behavior would be the same. The new _fmap_search_header uses logic translated from vboot_reference/host/lib/fmap.c and tries to find the right FMAP using best alignment values. [Autotest] make touch_TapSettings test use input events. Make this test use the new common events test page. Instead of custom handlers on test_page.html, use the common handlers from this page that record all input events in a log. Use the input events log to figure out whether any dragging happened, since a drag is a mousedown, followed by movement, followed by a mouseup. (The same playback without tap-dragging enabled gives us mousedown, mouseup, followed by movement.) Also use the events test page's global click count. In the event of any error, dump the touch events that the page saw into logs for later debugging. TEST=ran it on several devices BUG=chromium:583437 Change-Id: I38d69e403086151a84618f3fd2215b00f0f9bbed Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/327691 Commit-Ready: Katherine Threlkeld <kathrelkeld@chromium.org> Tested-by: Katherine Threlkeld <kathrelkeld@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Katherine Threlkeld <kathrelkeld@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: Add reconnect mechanism to HFP/HSP A2DP has reconnect mechanism implemented in plugin/policy.c, at connection failure with err code -EAGAIN, a timer will be scheduled to initiate connection in 2 seconds. A confusing scenario is observed occasionally that user got only A2DP when a BT headset is connected, but not HFP or HSP. When it happens, user is unable to use bidrectional audio, and with headset disconnected and then reconnected, both A2DP and HFP/HSP work fine. This change adds similar reconnect mechanism for HFP/HSP, so that Chrome OS users can have more consistent experience on BT audio. BUG=chromium:527575 TEST=Connect BT headset, disconnect and reconnect. Verify this audio device cab be used for A2DP and HFP/HSP.
